title: AI-based worker guidance in assembly and disassembly operations using multimodal ego/exo-centric data capture and structured task knowledge
abstract: arXiv:2608.22617v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Assembly and disassembly processes rely on expert knowledge that is difficult to document, reuse, and transfer. This paper presents a data-centric approach for extracting structured task knowledge from expert demonstrations using egocentric and exocentric recordings. Temporal and multimodal information from video and narration is jointly encoded to derive structured task representations that enable procedural documentation and context-aware worker guidance. The approach is evaluated on a real-world disassembly case study, demonstrating that video-based representations capture procedural structure and execution context beyond static image-based methods. The results highlight the potential of egocentric video understanding for repair, training, and circular manufacturing applications. Project website: https://indego-assistant.github.io/

translated_title: 基于多模态自我/外部中心数据捕获与结构化任务知识的人工智能辅助装配与拆卸作业指导
translated_abstract: 装配和拆卸过程依赖于难以记录、复用和转移的专家知识。本文提出了一种数据驱动的方法，利用自我中心和外部中心记录从专家演示中提取结构化任务知识。视频和叙述中的时间与多模态信息被联合编码，以推导出结构化任务表示，从而支持程序性文档和情境感知的工人指导。该方法在真实世界的拆卸案例研究中进行了评估，结果表明基于视频的表示能够捕捉程序结构和执行情境，超越了静态图像方法。结果强调了自我中心视频理解在维修、培训和循环制造应用中的潜力。项目网站：https://indego-assistant.github.io/
tldr: 本文提出了一种利用自我和外部中心视频数据与多模态编码提取结构化任务知识的方法，用于装配拆卸作业的情境感知工人指导，并在实际案例中验证了其优于静态图像方法的程序结构捕获能力。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a method that leverages egocentric and exocentric video data with multimodal encoding to extract structured task knowledge for context-aware worker guidance in assembly and disassembly, demonstrating superior procedural capture over static image methods in a real-world case study.
